name: Watashi no Musume wa Hanasu Koto ga Dekimasen
original_name: 私の娘 は話すことができません
source:
After years of relentless effort, the protagonist finally achieves their lifelong dream. However, upon realizing this dream, they are overcome with a deep sense of emptiness and numbness. One day, while drowning their sorrows in alcohol, they come across a mysterious girl at the train station...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3382360/My_Dear_Cant_Speak/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经过多年的不懈努力，主人公终于实现了毕生的梦想。然而，当实现这个梦想时，他们却感到深深的空虚和麻木。某天，他们借酒浇愁，在火车站遇到了一位神秘的女孩……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3382360/My_Dear_Cant_Speak/]Steam[/url]]
